appName.message: Slipstream Live — Detect and Adjust Live Stream Latency Automatically

appDesc.message: Automatically detects stream latency on YouTube, Twitch, and TwitCasting. Smartly adjusts playback speed to always catch up to the live edge in real time.

speedupDesc.message: Automatically speeds up when there is sufficient buffer to catch up to the live edge. Returns to normal speed once caught up or if the buffer drops.

speedupRateDesc.message: Higher values catch up faster, but consume buffer more quickly, increasing the risk of buffering pauses.

speedupThresholdDesc.message: The buffer threshold to start accelerating. Lower values catch up faster, but increase the risk of buffering pauses.

speedupAutoDesc.message: Optimizes the buffer threshold automatically for the current stream. Off: uses the 'Speed-up buffer threshold' instead. Standard: judges conservatively and speeds up less often. Aggressive: closes the gap to live, but enters maximum slowdown more often.

floorDesc.message: Reduces playback to minimum speed (0.15x) when buffer is depleted to maintain playback and avoid a total freeze.

floorThresholdDesc.message: The final safety threshold triggered just before a complete freeze. Playback drops to 0.15x while buffer health stays below this value.

floorThresholdNote_twitch.message: On Twitch, video data chunks may pause for around 10 seconds. The default value is set higher to prevent complete playback pauses.

duckDesc.message: Suppresses stretched audio during maximum slowdown to reduce discomfort. Temporarily lowers volume and automatically restores original volume when returning to normal speed.

duckVolumeDesc.message: Specifies volume during maximum slowdown. 50 is half volume, 0 is mute, and 100 leaves volume unchanged.

showPlaybackRateDesc.message: Displays current playback speed. Text color changes based on status (White: normal, Red: speeding up, Blue: maximum slowdown emergency).

showLatencyDesc.message: Displays latency (time lag) from the live edge in real time.

showHealthDesc.message: Displays remaining buffer time that can sustain playback without pausing.

resetDesc.message: Resets settings in this section to default values.

scopeCommonDesc.message: This setting applies to all supported sites.
